title: Waiting in line
story:
Waiting in line

Leo is having a moment when Leo is waiting in line at the grocery store and feels upset because people are talking loudly.. This can feel big and overwhelming, and it is okay to take a pause. When they/them notices the feeling growing, Leo can use counting to five. Leo can ask for help, move to a quieter space, or take a break. Leo is safe, supported, and learning what helps. The adults around they/them can stay calm and kind. Together, they can make a plan to feel more comfortable and ready for the next step.
